cohort: 60 patients coming into labor at Banha University Hospital.
finding: Sonographic measurement of placental thickness (with a best cutoff value of 46 mm) and umbilical cord cross-sectional area (with a best cutoff value of 2.40 cm2) are good predictors for fetal macrosomia.
birth_weight: Includes babies with macrosomia (>= 4000g) and average birth weight babies.
